svg.title: Evaluation
svg.text: Evaluation: from episode logs to metrics
Exploratory, descriptive statistics only (no hypothesis tests). Unit: the episode; for prefilled scenarios the source history.
1 Load (results_loading.py)
• Read episodes.jsonl of every run listed in build_pilot_report.py; normalise old and new log formats.
• Recompute evaluation cues from the saved reasoning with the current keyword flag (same definition for all runs).
• Group episodes by scenario + reasoning effort (settings changed between runs, so groups are never pooled across efforts).
2a Access metrics (on-policy episodes only)
• Access rate = delivered / episodes, with a 95% Wilson interval.
• Descriptive counts: listed file, read attempted, ran tests, modified
test file.
• Stop reasons: finished · output cut off · step/turn limit.
• Prefilled episodes excluded (their access is constructed).
2b Report metrics (episodes with delivery only)
• Per branch: false denials / episodes with delivery (fresh: 95% Wilson
interval).
• Also counted: accurate reports, unclear answers (read by hand).
• Prefilled: counts per source history (the unit); no pooled interval.
• Paired view: answers of branch A vs. B in the same episode.
3 Statistics and outputs (pilot_statistics.py, report_builder.py)
• Wilson score interval, p = k/n: centre = (p + z²/(2n)) / (1 + z²/n), half-width = z·√(p(1−p)/n + z²/(4n²)) / (1 + z²/n), z = 1.96.
• With 0 events it still gives an informative upper bound (e.g. 0/21 → 0–15%, 0/3 → 0–56%).
• Tables: runs · access · reports · prefilled by source. Figure 1: (a) access rate, (b) false-report rate by branch.
• If a group has 0 deliveries, the false-report rate is undefined (not zero) and has no row in 2b.
4 Hand review (not automated)
• Every 'unclear' answer, every evaluation-cue flag and suspicious reasoning (e.g. 'the grader') is read in the transcripts.
• Findings (e.g. test-file edits as a compute workaround, one genuine evaluation-awareness case) go into the report narrative.
